topics.topic: Request scope of the one-monotonic-reading rule
questions: Does “one reading per request” mean every HTTP request, or only every viewer-entry request to which the rate limiter applies?

quotes: install_transport_guards: [ORCHESTRATION] MUST register exactly one FastAPI http middleware on the supplied application. For every request the middleware MUST evaluate the checks below in the order they are written, and the order is a pipeline rather than a choice between alternatives: each check either produces the response named for it and ends the request there, or leaves the request untouched for the next check to evaluate. A check that does not produce a response MUST NOT call the next handler, MUST NOT return, and MUST NOT cause any later check to be skipped; the next handler is called exactly once, after every check in the list has left the request unrefused. The checks are: derive a request id carrying no identity or credential material; reject the request with 400 when _host_allowed refuses the request host against settings.trusted_hosts; answer an OPTIONS request carrying an Origin listed in settings.allowed_origins with a 204 preflight echoing the requested method and headers plus Vary Origin, together with the allow-origin and allow-credentials headers every allowed-origin response carries, and reject an unlisted origin with 403; reject POST on the canonical viewer logout path /auth/viewer/logout with 403 unless _normalized_origin of the request Origin equals _normalized_origin of settings.public_origin; reject with 413 when _body_within_limit refuses the declared Content-Length against settings.max_request_body_bytes; reject with 429 when _record_viewer_entry_attempt refuses a POST on the canonical viewer entry path /auth/viewer/enter, keyed by _client_bucket_key, before any credential parsing or verification. A POST to /auth/viewer/logout whose Origin is accepted therefore still passes through the body-size check, and so does every other request that is not refused before it. It MUST supply _record_viewer_entry_attempt with one reading of monotonic_seconds per entry attempt, a clock that cannot move backwards, never with wall-clock time and never with a host clock read directly, so that adjusting the system clock cannot widen the window or discard recorded attempts.
judgement.why: The State 7 note limits the monotonic reading to each viewer-entry attempt, so unrelated requests such as liveness do not read it for this rule.
